title: Greed brought under honorable speech
subtitle: For appetite that has started talking through the mouth
description: The shabad names greed, falsehood, slander, and anger with unsparing force. These readings bring appetite under the question of what speech can stand at the Lord’s Door.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Greed degrades the mouth when appetite is allowed to become language.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before wanting speaks, ask whether the sentence would bring honor before the Lord.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey confronts greed where it becomes speech, justification, and appetite with a voice.
evidence.turn: Greed weakens when the mouth is made answerable to honor.
evidence.practicalImplication: Refuse one sentence that flatters appetite, and speak one sentence that restores truth.
